note: The root key records the consonants of the place name. Its derivation is uncertain.
summary: Genesis 10:19 names Lasha as a point on the Canaanite boundary. It is the last place named in the description.

senses.definition: A place marking a limit of Canaanite territory.

evidence.note: The repeated עַד marks the reach of the boundary, first “as far as Gaza” and finally “as far as Lasha.”
